```{=html}
<div class="rs-explorer" id="rs-explorer">
  <div class="rsx-head">
    <span class="rsx-tag" data-i18n-en="Interactive" data-i18n-id="Interaktif">Interactive</span>
    <span class="rsx-title" data-i18n-en="Spectral signature and index explorer"
          data-i18n-id="Penjelajah tanda tangan spektral dan indeks">Spectral signature and index explorer</span>
  </div>

  <p class="rsx-lead" data-i18n-en="Pick two land cover types and an index. The chart shows their reflectance across the spectrum; the bar below shows how far apart the index puts them. An index that leaves the two bars nearly equal cannot separate those classes, whatever the map looks like."
     data-i18n-id="Pilih dua tipe tutupan lahan dan satu indeks. Grafik menunjukkan reflektansi keduanya di sepanjang spektrum; batang di bawahnya menunjukkan seberapa jauh indeks itu memisahkan keduanya. Indeks yang menghasilkan dua batang hampir sama tidak bisa memisahkan kelas itu, seperti apa pun tampilan petanya.">
    Pick two land cover types and an index. The chart shows their reflectance across the spectrum;
    the bar below shows how far apart the index puts them.
  </p>

  <div class="rsx-controls">
    <label class="rsx-field">
      <span data-i18n-en="Class A" data-i18n-id="Kelas A">Class A</span>
      <select id="rsx-a"></select>
    </label>
    <label class="rsx-field">
      <span data-i18n-en="Class B" data-i18n-id="Kelas B">Class B</span>
      <select id="rsx-b"></select>
    </label>
    <label class="rsx-field">
      <span data-i18n-en="Index" data-i18n-id="Indeks">Index</span>
      <select id="rsx-index"></select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <svg id="rsx-chart" viewBox="0 0 700 260" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"></svg>

  <div id="rsx-result" class="rsx-result"></div>
  <div id="rsx-verdict" class="rsx-verdict"></div>
</div>

<style>
.rs-explorer{border:1px solid var(--lms-rule,#e4e0d8);border-left:3px solid var(--lms-bright,#14a37f);
  border-radius:6px;background:var(--lms-sand,#faf8f4);padding:1.2rem 1.3rem 1.4rem;margin:2rem 0;
  font-family:"Source Sans 3",system-ui,sans-serif}
.rsx-head{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:.7rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.rsx-tag{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--lms-teal,#0f6b57)}
.rsx-title{font-size:1rem;font-weight:600}
.rsx-lead{font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(--lms-muted,#5c6773);margin:0 0 1rem}
.rsx-controls{display:flex;gap:.9rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1rem}
.rsx-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.25rem;flex:1 1 150px}
.rsx-field span{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--lms-muted,#5c6773)}
.rsx-field select{font-family:inherit;font-size:.88rem;padding:.45rem .55rem;border-radius:5px;
  border:1px solid var(--lms-rule,#e4e0d8);background:#fff;color:inherit}
#rsx-chart{width:100%;height:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:5px;
  border:1px solid var(--lms-rule,#e4e0d8)}
.rsx-result{margin-top:1rem}
.rsx-bar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;margin:.35rem 0;font-size:.85rem}
.rsx-bar-label{width:120px;text-align:right;color:var(--lms-muted,#5c6773)}
.rsx-bar-track{flex:1;height:20px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--lms-rule,#e4e0d8);
  border-radius:3px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.rsx-bar-fill{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;transition:all .25s ease}
.rsx-bar-zero{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;background:#c9c4bb}
.rsx-bar-value{width:56px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:600}
.rsx-verdict{margin-top:.9rem;padding:.7rem .9rem;border-radius:5px;font-size:.87rem;line-height:1.5}
.rsx-good{background:rgba(20,163,127,.12);border-left:3px solid #14a37f}
.rsx-weak{background:rgba(200,121,43,.14);border-left:3px solid #c8792b}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  var host = document.getElementById('rs-explorer');
  if (!host) return;

  var isID = (document.documentElement.lang || 'en').slice(0,2) === 'id';

  // Translate any element carrying data-i18n attributes.
  host.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-en]').forEach(function (el) {
    el.textContent = isID ? el.getAttribute('data-i18n-id') : el.getAttribute('data-i18n-en');
  });

  // Representative Sentinel-2 surface reflectance per class.
  // These are typical published values, not a measurement of one place.
  // Bands: B2 490, B3 560, B4 665, B5 705, B6 740, B8 842, B11 1610, B12 2190.
  var CLASSES = {
    'Healthy mangrove':   {id:'Mangrove sehat',  r:{B2:.030,B3:.055,B4:.030,B5:.075,B6:.240,B8:.310,B11:.115,B12:.050}},
    'Other dense forest': {id:'Hutan lebat lain',r:{B2:.028,B3:.052,B4:.029,B5:.072,B6:.245,B8:.330,B11:.135,B12:.060}},
    'Oil palm':           {id:'Kelapa sawit',    r:{B2:.032,B3:.060,B4:.035,B5:.080,B6:.250,B8:.345,B11:.155,B12:.070}},
    'Open water':         {id:'Air terbuka',     r:{B2:.045,B3:.040,B4:.025,B5:.018,B6:.012,B8:.008,B11:.004,B12:.003}},
    'Turbid water':       {id:'Air keruh',       r:{B2:.075,B3:.090,B4:.080,B5:.060,B6:.040,B8:.028,B11:.010,B12:.006}},
    'Tidal mudflat':      {id:'Lumpur pasut',    r:{B2:.070,B3:.100,B4:.130,B5:.150,B6:.170,B8:.195,B11:.230,B12:.190}},
    'Bare soil':          {id:'Tanah terbuka',   r:{B2:.090,B3:.130,B4:.180,B5:.210,B6:.235,B8:.265,B11:.330,B12:.290}},
    'Built up':           {id:'Terbangun',       r:{B2:.130,B3:.150,B4:.170,B5:.180,B6:.190,B8:.205,B11:.240,B12:.220}}
  };

  var WL = {B2:490,B3:560,B4:665,B5:705,B6:740,B8:842,B11:1610,B12:2190};

  var nd = function (a, b) { return (a - b) / (a + b); };

  var INDICES = {
    'NDVI': {
      en:'(NIR - Red)/(NIR + Red)', f:function(r){return nd(r.B8,r.B4);},
      noteEN:'Separates vegetation from everything else, and saturates over dense canopy.',
      noteID:'Memisahkan vegetasi dari yang lain, dan jenuh di atas tajuk rapat.'},
    'NDWI': {
      en:'(Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR)', f:function(r){return nd(r.B3,r.B8);},
      noteEN:'Finds open water, and reads built surfaces as water too.',
      noteID:'Menemukan air terbuka, dan membaca permukaan terbangun sebagai air juga.'},
    'MNDWI': {
      en:'(Green - SWIR1)/(Green + SWIR1)', f:function(r){return nd(r.B3,r.B11);},
      noteEN:'Water again, with the built up confusion largely removed.',
      noteID:'Air lagi, dengan kekeliruan area terbangun sebagian besar hilang.'},
    'CMRI': {
      en:'NDVI - NDWI', f:function(r){return nd(r.B8,r.B4) - nd(r.B3,r.B8);},
      noteEN:'Built for mangrove: vegetated AND wet at the same time.',
      noteID:'Dibuat untuk mangrove: bervegetasi DAN basah sekaligus.'},
    'MVI': {
      en:'(NIR - Green)/(SWIR1 - Green)',
      f:function(r){var d=r.B11-r.B3; if(Math.abs(d)<0.001) d=0.001; return (r.B8-r.B3)/d;},
      noteEN:'Unbounded, so watch the denominator. Strong on mangrove against terrestrial forest.',
      noteID:'Tidak terbatas, jadi awasi penyebutnya. Kuat untuk mangrove lawan hutan daratan.'},
    'Red edge slope': {
      en:'(B6 - B5)/(740 - 705)', f:function(r){return (r.B6-r.B5)/35*100;},
      noteEN:'Steepness of the red edge. Landsat cannot compute this at all.',
      noteID:'Kecuraman red edge. Landsat sama sekali tidak bisa menghitungnya.'}
  };

  var selA = document.getElementById('rsx-a');
  var selB = document.getElementById('rsx-b');
  var selI = document.getElementById('rsx-index');

  Object.keys(CLASSES).forEach(function (k) {
    [selA, selB].forEach(function (sel) {
      var o = document.createElement('option');
      o.value = k; o.textContent = isID ? CLASSES[k].id : k;
      sel.appendChild(o);
    });
  });
  Object.keys(INDICES).forEach(function (k) {
    var o = document.createElement('option');
    o.value = k; o.textContent = k;
    selI.appendChild(o);
  });

  selA.value = 'Healthy mangrove';
  selB.value = 'Other dense forest';
  selI.value = 'NDVI';

  var BANDS = ['B2','B3','B4','B5','B6','B8','B11','B12'];

  function draw() {
    var a = CLASSES[selA.value].r, b = CLASSES[selB.value].r;
    var svg = document.getElementById('rsx-chart');
    var W = 700, H = 260, L = 46, R = 16, T = 18, B = 42;
    var xw = W - L - R, yh = H - T - B;

    var xs = function (w) { return L + (Math.log(w) - Math.log(450)) /
      (Math.log(2300) - Math.log(450)) * xw; };
    var ys = function (v) { return T + yh - (v / 0.40) * yh; };

    var parts = [];
    // grid
    [0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4].forEach(function (v) {
      parts.push('<line x1="'+L+'" y1="'+ys(v)+'" x2="'+(W-R)+'" y2="'+ys(v)+
        '" stroke="#eee" stroke-width="1"/>');
      parts.push('<text x="'+(L-8)+'" y="'+(ys(v)+3.5)+'" font-size="9" fill="#8b97a3" text-anchor="end">'+
        v.toFixed(1)+'</text>');
    });
    // band ticks
    BANDS.forEach(function (bd) {
      parts.push('<text x="'+xs(WL[bd])+'" y="'+(H-24)+'" font-size="8.5" fill="#8b97a3" text-anchor="middle">'+bd+'</text>');
      parts.push('<text x="'+xs(WL[bd])+'" y="'+(H-12)+'" font-size="7.5" fill="#c0bcb4" text-anchor="middle">'+WL[bd]+'</text>');
    });

    function path(r, colour) {
      var d = BANDS.map(function (bd, i) {
        return (i ? 'L' : 'M') + xs(WL[bd]).toFixed(1) + ' ' + ys(r[bd]).toFixed(1);
      }).join(' ');
      var dots = BANDS.map(function (bd) {
        return '<circle cx="'+xs(WL[bd]).toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+ys(r[bd]).toFixed(1)+
          '" r="3" fill="'+colour+'"/>';
      }).join('');
      return '<path d="'+d+'" fill="none" stroke="'+colour+'" stroke-width="2.2" '+
        'stroke-linejoin="round"/>' + dots;
    }

    parts.push(path(a, '#14a37f'));
    parts.push(path(b, '#c8792b'));
    parts.push('<text x="'+(L+6)+'" y="'+(T+12)+'" font-size="10" fill="#14a37f" font-weight="600">'+
      (isID ? CLASSES[selA.value].id : selA.value)+'</text>');
    parts.push('<text x="'+(L+6)+'" y="'+(T+26)+'" font-size="10" fill="#c8792b" font-weight="600">'+
      (isID ? CLASSES[selB.value].id : selB.value)+'</text>');
    parts.push('<text x="'+(L-34)+'" y="'+(T+yh/2)+'" font-size="9" fill="#8b97a3" '+
      'transform="rotate(-90 '+(L-34)+' '+(T+yh/2)+')" text-anchor="middle">'+
      (isID?'Reflektansi':'Reflectance')+'</text>');

    svg.innerHTML = parts.join('');

    // index bars
    var idx = INDICES[selI.value];
    var va = idx.f(a), vb = idx.f(b);
    var span = Math.max(Math.abs(va), Math.abs(vb), 1) * 1.15;

    function bar(label, v, colour) {
      var zero = 50, pct = (v / span) * 50;
      var left = v >= 0 ? zero : zero + pct;
      return '<div class="rsx-bar-row">' +
        '<span class="rsx-bar-label">'+label+'</span>' +
        '<span class="rsx-bar-track">' +
          '<span class="rsx-bar-zero" style="left:50%"></span>' +
          '<span class="rsx-bar-fill" style="left:'+left+'%;width:'+Math.abs(pct)+
            '%;background:'+colour+'"></span>' +
        '</span>' +
        '<span class="rsx-bar-value">'+v.toFixed(3)+'</span></div>';
    }

    document.getElementById('rsx-result').innerHTML =
      '<div style="font-size:.78rem;color:#5c6773;margin-bottom:.4rem">' +
      selI.value + ' = <code>' + idx.en + '</code></div>' +
      bar(isID ? CLASSES[selA.value].id : selA.value, va, '#14a37f') +
      bar(isID ? CLASSES[selB.value].id : selB.value, vb, '#c8792b');

    var sep = Math.abs(va - vb);
    var scale = selI.value === 'MVI' || selI.value === 'Red edge slope' ? 1.0 : 0.12;
    var good = sep > scale;
    var v = document.getElementById('rsx-verdict');
    v.className = 'rsx-verdict ' + (good ? 'rsx-good' : 'rsx-weak');
    v.innerHTML = '<strong>' +
      (good ? (isID ? 'Terpisah: ' : 'Separable: ')
            : (isID ? 'Tidak terpisah: ' : 'Not separable: ')) +
      (isID ? 'selisih ' : 'gap of ') + sep.toFixed(3) + '</strong> &nbsp;' +
      (isID ? idx.noteID : idx.noteEN) +
      (good ? '' : ' ' + (isID
        ? 'Classifier tidak akan memisahkan kedua kelas ini dengan indeks ini saja. Bab 10, 11 dan 14 menambahkan radar, elevasi dan tekstur justru untuk kasus seperti ini.'
        : 'A classifier will not separate these two on this index alone. Chapters 10, 11 and 14 add radar, elevation and texture for exactly this case.'));
  }

  [selA, selB, selI].forEach(function (s) { s.addEventListener('change', draw); });
  draw();
})();
</script>
```
